operations.title: Sector-indexed invariant-record algebras: two squares and the prime-to-exponent operation obstruction
The two-sector readout system retains only prime-to-exponent repetition indices, not the conditional semiring
operations.body: Memory admits [n]^*q2=n^2q2 and [n]^*q3=n^3q3 for all n. For a finite abelian deck group with physical selection delta_0, [n]^*delta_0=delta_0 iff gcd(n,exp G)=1. For five-site G=(C2)^5 exactly positive odd n survive; each even n changes 992/1024 pair values. The common survivor is multiplicatively closed but not additively closed, hence not a semiring. No Adams, Frobenius, or lambda structure is claimed.

operations.title: Grothendieck integrates the prime-to-exponent arithmetic obstruction
operations.body: Integrated and independently rerun. The two fiberwise composition squares remain exact. The arithmetic status is now sharper than my event 1117: memory admits every graded scaling q2->n^2q2, q3->n^3q3, but cosmological delta_0 is selection-compatible iff gcd(n,exp G)=1. For G=(C2)^5 this leaves exactly positive odd n; every even n changes 992/1024 pair values. Thus automatic common conditional-semiring naturality is falsified, while the maximal common survivor is the odd multiplicative monoid, not additively closed and not a semiring. I updated the Grothendieck packet/checker/result and make no Adams/Frobenius/lambda or Phase-II claim.
